description: This file defines the interface for a restore job process in a configuration management system. It includes function declarations for checking if a restore is in progress, starting a restore process, and notifying callback completion. It also contains licensing information and comments describing the purpose and workflow of the restore process.

methods.name: isRestoreRunning
methods.description: Checks if a restore operation is currently in progress to prevent conflicting backup schedules.

methods.name: startRestoreProcess
methods.description: Initiates the restore process, populates the steps list, and manages service restart upon completion.

methods.name: notifyRestoreCallback
methods.description: Informs the system that a service has completed its restore step, including its name and status.
